brushPacks/basic.description: Everyday marks, the brushes to reach for first.

brushes/airbrush.description: A fully soft disc that builds color up gradually; hold it in one place and the tone deepens.

brushes/calligraphy.description: A broad elliptical nib held at a fixed angle, so strokes thicken and thin with direction.

brushes/ink_pen.description: A crisp-edged nib with a slow pressure ramp, for confident line work that holds its weight.

brushes/rough_ink.description: An ink nib whose edge is reshaped at random every dab, producing line work that looks bitten rather than printed.
